summary: 书评考察米森关于音乐起源的解释，尤其是音乐与语言的共同演化，以及音乐在身体动作和群体交流中的作用。作者肯定其跨学科论证，并质疑现代人的音乐能力因语言发展而受限的推论。
logic: 拆解音乐所需的多种能力
引入演化假说及学科证据
联系动作情绪与群体活动
用跨文化实例检验推论

paragraphs.brief: 并影响音乐记忆能力、对旋律的歧视、对改变和谐的意识，甚至还有保持时间的能力。
sentences: Why is musical behavior universal?
为什么音乐行为是普遍的？
What could be its adaptive, or survival, value?
它的适应性，或生存价值是什么？
And just what is music anyway?
音乐到底是什么？
Like speech, it is not one identifiable cognitive capacity but is composed of multiple separate components.
与演讲一样，它不是一种可识别的认知能力，而是由多种不同的组成部分组成。
Pitch recognition varies from ‘tone deaf’ to ‘perfect’ and influences abilities for musical memory, discrimination of melodies, awareness of changing harmony, and even the ability to keep time.
并影响音乐记忆能力、对旋律的歧视、对改变和谐的意识，甚至还有保持时间的能力。
Other components of music include perception of melody, meter, and rhythm.
音乐的其他组成部分包括对旋律、计量和节奏的感知。
Often disregarded are additional important abilities to synchronize and take turns.
经常被忽略的是其他重要的同步和轮流能力。
Individuals vary in their endowment of these different features, and individual cultures vary in the importance they give to a particular musical feature.
个人具有这些不同特点，而个人文化对某一音乐特点的重视程度也各不相同。

paragraphs.brief: 史蒂文·米瑟是英国阅读大学的认知考古学家和早期史前教授，他大胆地处理了人类音乐的起源和适应价值这个棘手的课题。
sentences: Steven Mithen, a cognitive archeologist and professor of early prehistory at Reading University in England, has boldly tackled the difficult subject of the origin and adaptive value of human music.
史蒂文·米瑟是英国阅读大学的认知考古学家和早期史前教授，他大胆地处理了人类音乐的起源和适应价值这个棘手的课题。
Whether or not one is convinced by his concluding hypothesis, his book The Singing Neanderthals* is a treasure trove of information and analysis relevant to understanding the evolution of music.
无论人们是否相信他的结论性假设，他的书《唱尼安德特人》* 是了解音乐进化的信息和分析宝库。

Anyone who subsequently proposes another hypothesis will not be able to neglect the knowledge and questions set forth by Mithen, nor can his conclusions be ignored, based as they are on careful consideration and synthesis of this vast range of specialist material.
任何后来提出另一个假设的人，都不能忽视Mithen提出的知识和问题，也不能忽视他的结论，因为这些结论是以仔细审议和综合这一系列广泛的专门材料为基础的。

paragraphs.brief: Mithen正确地赞扬他的前任，包括John Blacking(1973年)和Nils Wallin(1991年)在研究音乐演进方面。
sentences: Mithen rightly pays tribute to his predecessors in the study of the evolution of music, including John Blacking (1973) and Nils Wallin (1991).
Mithen正确地赞扬他的前任，包括John Blacking(1973年)和Nils Wallin(1991年)在研究音乐演进方面。
Although both contributed important insights and were themselves musically trained, they did not (and at the time could not) command the resources Mithen brings to bear.
虽然两者都提供了重要的见解，而且本身也经过音乐培训，但它们并没有(当时也无法)掌握Mithen带来的资源。

paragraphs.brief: 米森考虑在最新的音乐综合演进假设中提出的想法，并将这些想法纳入他逐渐编织成两大主题的阵营。
sentences: Anthropologist and performing classical musician Blacking’s ideas lacked evidence from archeology and neurology, while neuroscientist and musicologist Wallin neglected paleontology and ethnomusicology.
人类学家和表演古典音乐家布莱克林的想法缺乏考古学和神经学的证据，而神经科学家和音乐学家瓦林则忽视古生物学和民族音乐学。
Mithen considers ideas proposed in more recent comprehensive evolutionary hypotheses of music and incorporates them into the strands that he gradually weaves into two major themes.
米森考虑在最新的音乐综合演进假设中提出的想法，并将这些想法纳入他逐渐编织成两大主题的阵营。
The first, proposed in a preliminary form by Steven Brown (2000), is the co-evolution of what we today call music and language.
第一个提案由Steven Brown(2000年)初步提出，是我们今天所称的音乐和语言的共同演变。

The second is a completely original hypothesis of the existence among Neanderthals of a proto-music language that was holistic (not composed of segmented elements), manipulative (influencing emotional states and hence responses of oneself and others), multimodal (using both sound and movement), musical (temporally controlled, rhythmic, and melodic), and mimetic (utilizing sound symbolism and gesture) — what Mithen terms ‘the “Hmmmmm” communication system … a prelinguistic musical mode of thought and action.’
第二种是完全原始的假设，即在尼安德特人中存在着一种整体性的原音乐语言(不是由分解元素组成)、操纵性语言(影响情绪状态，从而影响自己和他人的反应)、多式联运语言(同时使用声音和运动)、音乐语言(同时控制、节奏和旋律)以及模拟语言语言(使用声音符号和手势)，Mithen所说的"hmmmm"通讯系统... 一种语言论的音乐模式思想和动作。

paragraphs.brief: 米森的假说考虑到多数音乐讨论都会忽略的要点。他认识到音乐通常伴随身体动作，如脚打拍子、点头、拍手和跳舞。他还指出：“音乐创作首先是一项共同参与的活动。这一点既适用于现代西方世界，也贯穿人类不同文化与整个历史。”
sentences: Mithen’s hypotheses account for important aspects that are usually excluded in the majority of discussions of music: he appreciates that it typically includes bodily movement (toe-tapping, head-nodding, hand-clapping, and dance) and that ‘music-making is first and foremost a shared activity, not just in the modern Western world, but throughout human cultures and history.’
米森的假说考虑到多数音乐讨论都会忽略的要点。他认识到音乐通常伴随身体动作，如脚打拍子、点头、拍手和跳舞。他还指出：“音乐创作首先是一项共同参与的活动。这一点既适用于现代西方世界，也贯穿人类不同文化与整个历史。”

Although he does not describe the musical behavior of Mbuti or Ba- Benjellé pygmies in Central Africa, or Kaluli villagers in the Southern Highlands of Papua New Guinea, as others have done, such small-scale societies well illustrate the ubiquity (and complexity) of communal singing during most daily activity — ‘woven tapestries’ (Meurant 1995) of sound that may even incorporate the natural sounds of the forest (Feld 2001).
虽然他没有像其他人一样描述中非姆布提或巴贝耶雷俾格米人或巴布亚新几内亚南部高地卡卢利村民的音乐行为，但这种小规模的社会清楚地说明了社区唱歌在大多数日常活动中的无处不在(和复杂性)—— " 编织的挂毯 " (Murant，1995年)，声音甚至可能包含森林的自然声音(Feld，2001年)。

paragraphs.brief: 尤其欢迎Mithen在一般的交流和认知研究中强调获得情感智慧的重要性，即以脸部、声音和身体来沟通情感的能力，以及在日益复杂的社会互动中解码他人情感信号的能力。
sentences: Especially welcome to communication and cognitive studies in general is Mithen’s emphasis on the importance of acquiring emotional intelligence — the ability to communicate one’s feelings with face, voice, and body, and to decode the emotional signals of others in increasingly complex social interactions.
尤其欢迎Mithen在一般的交流和认知研究中强调获得情感智慧的重要性，即以脸部、声音和身体来沟通情感的能力，以及在日益复杂的社会互动中解码他人情感信号的能力。
Mithen proposes that ‘vocal grooming’ (Aiello and Dunbar 1993) would have been initially musical more than verbal.
Mithen提议“口头调戏”(Aiello和Dunbar，1993年)最初的音乐内容应该多于口头。

Rather than emphasizing the competitive advantages of comprehending the intentions and desires of others, Mithen points out that the emotional content of musical vocalizations would have been more ‘honest’ than words — contributing to social commitment and expressing, inducing, and sharing emotion, especially happiness, thereby promoting selectively advantageous cooperative behavior.
Mithen没有强调理解他人意图和愿望的竞争优势，而是指出音乐发声的情感内容会比语言更 " 诚实 "，有助于社会承诺和表达、诱导和分享情感，特别是幸福，从而有选择地促进有利的合作行为。

paragraphs.brief: 然而，他完全不同意史蒂文·平克(1997年)现在臭名昭著的言论，即音乐虽然来自其他适应能力，但本身是边缘的，甚至非适应性的，就像对糖或脂肪的品味。
sentences: Mithen appreciates that behavior may have had more than one adaptive function — and admits that, at least in homo ergaster (a common ancestor of both Neanderthals and homo sapiens), ‘singing and dancing may have provided both indicator and esthetic traits for females when choosing mates.’
Mithen意识到行为可能具有一个以上的适应功能，并承认至少在同性恋者(尼安德特人和同性人共同的祖先)中，“唱歌和跳舞可能为选择伴侣的女性提供了指标和美学特征。

However, he disagrees completely with the now notorious pronouncement by Steven Pinker (1997) that music, although derived from other adaptive capacities, is itself peripheral and even nonadaptive — like a taste for sugar or fat.
然而，他完全不同意史蒂文·平克(1997年)现在臭名昭著的言论，即音乐虽然来自其他适应能力，但本身是边缘的，甚至非适应性的，就像对糖或脂肪的品味。
Music, says Mithen, is too different from language (or anything else) to be a spin-off.
Mithen说，音乐与语言(或其他任何语言)太不同了，不能成为副产品。
He makes the further point that the emotional power of music indicates a long evolutionary history, not a recent invention aimed at pleasure: ‘We don’t have emotions for fun.’
他进一步指出，音乐的情感力量表明了一个漫长的进化历史，而不是最近以快乐为目的的发明：`我们没有乐趣的情感'。

paragraphs.brief: 这本书既发人深省，又丰富多彩，但Mithen的一些说法令人怀疑。
sentences: The book is both thought-provoking and informative, but some of Mithen’s claims are questionable.
这本书既发人深省，又丰富多彩，但Mithen的一些说法令人怀疑。
He thinks that modern humans are relatively limited in their musical abilities compared to Neanderthals.
他认为现代人类的音乐能力相对而言有限与尼安德特人相比。
He suggests that the evolution of language has inhibited the musical abilities that modern humans have inherited from the common ancestor that we share with Neanderthals.
他建议说，语言的演化抑制了现代人类从我们与尼安德特人共同的祖先那里继承的音乐能力。
Yet here I think he slips into the Westernized assumptions about music that he decries elsewhere and reveals his own weak spot — insufficient acquaintance with the ethnomusicological literature.
但在这里，我认为他滑入西方化的假设音乐，他批评别处并暴露自己的弱点 - 不够熟悉民族音乐学文学。

It is not spoken language itself that stunts musical ability, but the factors in modernized societies that have made music a specialty — individuality, competitiveness, compartmentalization, and institutionalization — reinforced by the high degree of literate training required to read (and compose) musical scores as well as literary texts.
妨碍音乐能力的不是口语本身，而是使音乐成为特色的现代化社会的因素——个性、竞争力、分门别类和制度化——由于阅读(和撰写)音乐成绩和文学课文所需的识字培训程度很高而得到加强。

In small-scale pre-modern societies, everyone participates in music — regularly, spontaneously, and wholeheartedly — and benefits thereby from the many adaptive advantages Mithen recognizes and so expertly describes.
在小规模的现代前社会中，人人都经常、自发和全心全意地参加音乐，从而受益于Mithen所认识和非常专业的描述的许多适应优势。

音乐能力由许多不同元素组成。

items.zh: Mithen指出，对于尼安德特人和同性人常见的祖先来说，音乐能力在以下情况下可能具有相关性：

items.answer: D · is not the same in all traditions.

items.answer: C · must be acknowledged by anyone putting forward an alternative explanation.
items.solution: 任何人若提出其他解释，都必须予以承认。

items.solution: 虽然有用，但由于调查范围狭窄，因此是有限的。

items.zh: Mithen认为音乐的强烈情感影响
items.answer: E · is evidence that it has existed for a long time.
items.solution: 证明它已经存在了很长一段时间。

items.zh: 评论员不同意Mithen认为音乐能力
items.answer: B · has been limited by the development of speech.
items.solution: 由于言论的发展而受到限制。

items.en: Most discussions of music ignore its association with physical movement.
items.zh: 多数关于音乐的讨论忽视了音乐与物质运动的联系。
items.why: 原文说“多数讨论通常排除 (excluded) 身体运动这一重要面向"”,与题干“ignore”同义改写，因此 YES。

items.en: Evidence to support Mithen’s view that music is a shared activity can be found in small communities in remote locations today.
items.zh: 今天，在偏远地区的小社区中，可以找到支持米认为音乐是共同活动的证据。
items.why: 题干“remote locations / small communities today”对应文中举的当代小型社会例子 (Mbuti、Kaluli 等) 来说明“群体歌唱/共享活动的普遍性”,所以 YES。

items.en: Mithen believes that the musical quality of adult speech directed at babies is similar to the musical communication of Neanderthals.
items.zh: 米瑟认为成人针对婴儿的演讲的音乐质量与尼安德特人的音乐交流相似
items.why: 米森推测早期的声音交流更接近音乐而非言语。文中没有把成年人对婴儿的说话方式与尼安德特人的音乐交流作比较。

items.en: Mithen’s hypothesis about the adaptive function of music supports that of Steven Pinker.
items.zh: Mithen关于音乐适应功能的假设支持了Steven Pinker的观点。
items.why: 题干说“支持",原文是“完全不同意”,直接矛盾，因此 NO.

items.en: Modernised societies rely too heavily on electronically produced music.
items.zh: 现代化社会过于依赖电子制作的音乐。
items.why: 作者认为现代社会让音乐变成专业活动，并谈到竞争等社会因素。文中没有评价电子制作的音乐，更未说社会过度依赖它。
